title: Document details
description: Read page sizes, encryption state and fillable fields.

title: Page preview
description: Render a local page without saving a copy.

title: Unlock PDF
description: Remove restrictions or decrypt using the password you provide.

title: Protect PDF
description: Encrypt a new copy with an AES-256 opening password.

title: Test password candidates
description: Test up to 1000 supplied candidates for at most 60 seconds. Unknown strong passwords are not guaranteed recoverable.

title: Permanently redact
description: Remove marked content and scrub private metadata. Secure mode flattens pages into images.

title: Merge PDFs
description: Combine PDFs in the selected order.

title: Split PDF
description: Create separate copies by page groups or pages per part.

title: Extract pages
description: Create a PDF from selected pages.

title: Reorder pages
description: Arrange pages in a new order, including repeated pages.

title: Remove pages
description: Save a copy omitting selected pages.

title: Rotate pages
description: Rotate selected pages by right angles.

title: Compress PDF
description: Lossless cleanup and stream compression; size reduction is not guaranteed.

title: Repair PDF
description: Rewrite readable, recoverable PDF structure.

title: Images to PDF
description: Combine local images into image-sized or A4 pages.

title: Scans to PDF
description: Apply local contrast correction to selected photos and combine them.

title: PDF to images
description: Render selected pages as PNG or JPEG.

title: Office to PDF
description: Render local Office documents using LibreOffice when available.

title: Local HTML to PDF
description: Render self-contained static text and CSS. Scripts and external assets are blocked.

title: PDF to Word
description: Reconstruct editable document layout; complex formatting may differ.

title: PDF to slide images
description: Place a rendered page image on each slide. Text and objects are not independently editable.

title: PDF tables to Excel
description: Extract detected tables, with text-line worksheets where no tables are detected.

title: Extract text
description: Save searchable PDF text as UTF-8.

title: Extract embedded images
description: Save embedded raster images. Vector drawings require page rendering.

title: Extract text and layout
description: Export text blocks and coordinates as JSON or basic Markdown; no AI semantic model.

title: Watermark
description: Place centered translucent text on selected pages.

title: Page numbers
description: Add page numbers using a customizable template.

title: Crop pages
description: Change the visible page boundary. Cropping does not securely remove hidden content.

title: Add text
description: Place new text in a selected page area.

title: Annotate
description: Add a note, highlight or rectangle annotation.

title: Fill PDF form
description: Update existing fields and optionally flatten the filled form.

title: Place signature image
description: Place a visible signature image. Use Sign with certificate for a cryptographic signature.

title: Sign with certificate
description: Sign a new copy using your PKCS#12 certificate and verify its cryptographic integrity.

title: Verify digital signatures
description: Check signature integrity and supplied certificate trust offline; online revocation is not checked.

title: Offline OCR
description: Add searchable English, Korean or Chinese text using bundled recognition models.

title: Compare PDFs
description: Create a text diff and 72-DPI visual differences.

title: Extractive summary
description: Select representative existing sentences locally. No generative AI or model downloads.

title: PDF/A conversion
description: Create an archival copy and require independent veraPDF conformance validation before accepting it.

title: Check PDF/A conformance
description: Validate an existing document with veraPDF and save a report.

title: Offline translation
description: Translate English and Korean locally and create a bilingual document using bundled models.

title: Extract with Docling
description: Use local layout and table models to export Markdown and structured JSON.
